dialogues.jp: 気だるい身体をひきずりながら階段を降りる。
dialogues.en: I dragged myself down the stairs as I didn't feel well.
dialogues.text: I dragged myself down the stairs as I didn't feel well.

dialogues.jp:
と、居間からひょっこり顔を出した音夢と目が
合う。
dialogues.en: Then I saw Nemu looking out from the living room.
dialogues.text: Then I saw Nemu looking out from the living room.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、びっくり、兄さんだ♪」
dialogues.en: "You surprised me, niisan!"
dialogues.text: "You surprised me, niisan!"

dialogues.jp:
こういう時は猫というより、子犬のような感じ
で音夢は嬉しそうな顔をする。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked happy to see me.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked happy to see me.

dialogues.jp:
久しぶりの当たり前の朝が俺も嬉しいのだが、
それよりもかったるさが上回る。
dialogues.en:
I was happy to have a normal morning, but I felt overwhelmed
by tiredness.
dialogues.text:
I was happy to have a normal morning, but I felt overwhelmed
by tiredness.

dialogues.jp: 「びっくり？」
dialogues.en: "Surprised?"
dialogues.text: "Surprised?"

dialogues.jp: まだ半分寝ぼけた口が勝手に呟く。
dialogues.en: I felt like I was sleep-talking.
dialogues.text: I felt like I was sleep-talking.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まだ７時前だよ。トイレにでも起きたの？」
dialogues.en:
"It's before 7 o'clock. Did you wake up to go to the rest
room?"
dialogues.text:
"It's before 7 o'clock. Did you wake up to go to the rest
room?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん……あぁ、ちょっと郵便受けを見に」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... I've got to check the mailbox."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... I've got to check the mailbox."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「え、本当に起きたの？　春休みくらい、私が
　新聞とかとってくるよ」
dialogues.en:
"Did you get up just for that? I'll do it during spring
break."
dialogues.text:
"Did you get up just for that? I'll do it during spring
break."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いや……他にすることもないし、郵便受
　けを見る仕事は俺にやらせてくれないか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well...... I don't have anything else to do. Do you mind if
I at least keep this job?"
dialogues.text:
"Well...... I don't have anything else to do. Do you mind if
I at least keep this job?"

dialogues.jp:
上手い言い訳が見つからず、音夢の好意を逆手
にとるような言葉しか出なかった。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't find a good excuse and it sounded like I was
rejecting her nice offer.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't find a good excuse and it sounded like I was
rejecting her nice offer.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、例の進学ストップの通知は、まず
俺が確認したほうがいいだろうから。
dialogues.en:
But I thought I should check for the letter from school
about Nemu not being able to go back to school.
dialogues.text:
But I thought I should check for the letter from school
about Nemu not being able to go back to school.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「分かりました。お願いいたします」
dialogues.en: "I understand. Please do so."
dialogues.text: "I understand. Please do so."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.jp: ｛あくび／欠伸｝をかみ殺しながら足を靴に突っ込む。
dialogues.en: I put my foot in my shoe, whilst stifling a yawn.
dialogues.text: I put my foot in my shoe, whilst stifling a yawn.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうそう。私今日は、たまってたビデオ
　を片付けるつもりだから家に居るよ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, by the way, I'm going to finish watching the videos I
taped, so I'll be home all day."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, by the way, I'm going to finish watching the videos I
taped, so I'll be home all day."

dialogues.jp: ドアノブをつかみながら考える。
dialogues.en: I thought about it as I grabbed the door knob.
dialogues.text: I thought about it as I grabbed the door knob.

dialogues.jp: 「……お前の側にいる」
dialogues.en: "I'm going to be by your side."
dialogues.text: "I'm going to be by your side."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「へくし」
dialogues.en: "Achoo!"
dialogues.text: "Achoo!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……すん……あ、ごめん兄さん、なに？」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, niisan. What was that?"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, niisan. What was that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……なんでもねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Nothing......"
dialogues.text: "Nothing......"

dialogues.jp:
自分がバカみたいだと、熱くなった頬を冷やし
に外に出た。
dialogues.en: I walked outside feeling like an idiot.
dialogues.text: I walked outside feeling like an idiot.

dialogues.jp: 季節は完全に春になろうとしている。
dialogues.en: The season has changed into spring at last.
dialogues.text: The season has changed into spring at last.

dialogues.jp: 本校の入学式４月７日。
dialogues.en: The first day of school is on April 7th.
dialogues.text: The first day of school is on April 7th.

dialogues.jp: あと１０日もないわけだ。
dialogues.en: We have less than 10 days until then.
dialogues.text: We have less than 10 days until then.

dialogues.jp:
郵便受けを漁って、新聞とダイレクトメールを
確認して安堵を覚える。
dialogues.en:
I looked into the mailbox and found a newspaper and some
junk mail, but no letter from school.
dialogues.text:
I looked into the mailbox and found a newspaper and some
junk mail, but no letter from school.

dialogues.jp:
今だけは、育毛剤や結婚相談所のチラシですら
楽しく読めそうだ。
dialogues.en: I think I can happily look through junk mail for now.
dialogues.text: I think I can happily look through junk mail for now.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃぁ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「お、お前は散歩か？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you're going for a walk?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, you're going for a walk?"

dialogues.jp: 神への反逆者を持ち上げる。
dialogues.en: I picked up the weird creature.
dialogues.text: I picked up the weird creature.

dialogues.jp: 「うぉ！？　手触りは猫だな」
dialogues.en: "Wow! You do feel like a cat."
dialogues.text: "Wow! You do feel like a cat."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow?"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp:
「どっかにファスナーとか電池入れる場所でも
　あるんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Isn't there a zipper or some place I can put batteries
into?"
dialogues.text:
"Isn't there a zipper or some place I can put batteries
into?"

dialogues.jp:
ひっくり返したり、逆さまにしたりして確認し
てみる。
dialogues.en: I turned it upside down looking for that.
dialogues.text: I turned it upside down looking for that.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「くそ、本当に猫なのかお前は！？」
dialogues.en: "Shit, how can you be a real cat?"
dialogues.text: "Shit, how can you be a real cat?"

dialogues.jp: 朝から哲学的な問題にぶつかってしまう。
dialogues.en:
I had to ask the most difficult questions first thing in the
morning.
dialogues.text:
I had to ask the most difficult questions first thing in the
morning.

dialogues.jp:
「お前も飯食うか？　最近は俺が作ってるんだ
　ぞ」
dialogues.en: "Are you hungry? I'm cooking soon."
dialogues.text: "Are you hungry? I'm cooking soon."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃん♪」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「そうかそうか、嬉しいか」
dialogues.en: "So you're happy."
dialogues.text: "So you're happy."

dialogues.jp: うたまるを頭の上にのせて家に戻る。
dialogues.en: I put Utamaru on top of my head and went back inside.
dialogues.text: I put Utamaru on top of my head and went back inside.

dialogues.jp:
なぜか意志の｛そつう／疎通｝が出来てしまっているのだが、
この際気にすまい。
dialogues.en:
I decided not to think about why we understand each other so
easily.
dialogues.text:
I decided not to think about why we understand each other so
easily.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと音夢と遊んでやってくれや」
dialogues.en: "Go play with Nemu for a while."
dialogues.text: "Go play with Nemu for a while."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.jp: ぐい、とパジャマの｛すそ／裾｝がつままれる。
dialogues.en: Somebody grabbed me by the hem of my pajamas.
dialogues.text: Somebody grabbed me by the hem of my pajamas.

dialogues.jp: 「お、朝早いなさくら」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you're up early."
dialogues.text: "Hey, you're up early."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「おはよーお兄ちゃん、ボクはいつもこのくら
　いには起きてるよ」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, oniichan. I'm always up around this time."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, oniichan. I'm always up around this time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「えへへ……でも、ホントは畳の上で寝てるか
　らそんな感じなんだけどね」
dialogues.en: "It's because I sleep on tatami mats."
dialogues.text: "It's because I sleep on tatami mats."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そないか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ところで……うたまるを頭にのせてなにやっ
　てる？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyways, what are you doing with Utamaru on top of your
head?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyways, what are you doing with Utamaru on top of your
head?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp:
「ファーストレディーになるために、頭の上に
　物をのせて歩くのは常識だぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Everybody knows you practice walking with something on top
of your head in order to become the First Lady."
dialogues.text:
"Everybody knows you practice walking with something on top
of your head in order to become the First Lady."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃん……冗談でもファーストレディーっ
　て大統領夫人のことだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Oniichan, I know you're only joking, but the First Lady is
the wife of the President."
dialogues.text:
"Oniichan, I know you're only joking, but the First Lady is
the wife of the President."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「大宇宙からの電波を受信するために、どうし
　てもこいつが必要でな」
dialogues.en: "I needed her in order to catch radio waves from space."
dialogues.text: "I needed her in order to catch radio waves from space."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、冗談だぞ？」
dialogues.en: "You know I'm joking, right?"
dialogues.text: "You know I'm joking, right?"

dialogues.jp: 珍しくさくらが肩を落とすので驚く。
dialogues.en: It surprised me to see Sakura drop her shoulders.
dialogues.text: It surprised me to see Sakura drop her shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ＹＥＳ。そうなんだけどさぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I know that......"
dialogues.text: "Yes. I know that......"

dialogues.jp: なにか居心地悪そうにさくらが目を伏せる。
dialogues.en: Sakura looked down awkwardly.
dialogues.text: Sakura looked down awkwardly.

dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんさぁ……音夢ちゃんとキスした？」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan...... Did you kiss Nemu-chan?"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan...... Did you kiss Nemu-chan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh!?"
dialogues.text: "Huh!?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……やっぱり」
dialogues.en: "I knew it."
dialogues.text: "I knew it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、その……」
dialogues.en: "Well, you know......"
dialogues.text: "Well, you know......"

dialogues.jp: 美春やことりから話が広がったのか！？
dialogues.en: Did she hear it from Miharu or Kotori?
dialogues.text: Did she hear it from Miharu or Kotori?

dialogues.jp:
誰に対しても胸を張っていられると思っていた
が、なぜかさくらに気づかれたと分かると背筋
が震えた。
dialogues.en:
I thought I'll be proud of the fact and wouldn't hide it
from anybody, but it gave me chills down my back when I
realized Sakura found out about it.
dialogues.text:
I thought I'll be proud of the fact and wouldn't hide it
from anybody, but it gave me chills down my back when I
realized Sakura found out about it.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それってさぁ、おでこで熱計っていた時の事
　故とかさ、転んだひょうしとか……じゃない
　か」
dialogues.en:
"Was it an accident? Like when you were trying to check her
temperature on her forehead, or when you fell?"
dialogues.text:
"Was it an accident? Like when you were trying to check her
temperature on her forehead, or when you fell?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ……あぁ」
胸を押さえて頷く。
dialogues.en: I nodded as I covered my heart.
dialogues.text: I nodded as I covered my heart.

dialogues.jp: 「そうか。そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Right. That's right."
dialogues.text: "Right. That's right."

dialogues.jp:
さくらにだけは、最初に報告しておくべきだっ
た。
dialogues.en: I should have told Sakura first.
dialogues.text: I should have told Sakura first.

dialogues.jp: 「俺、音夢と恋人になった」
dialogues.en: "Nemu and I are boyfriend and girlfriend now."
dialogues.text: "Nemu and I are boyfriend and girlfriend now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ダメだって言ったのに！！」
dialogues.en: "I said you can't do that!!!"
dialogues.text: "I said you can't do that!!!"

dialogues.jp: さくらの叫びが空を打つ。
dialogues.en: Sakura yelled out.
dialogues.text: Sakura yelled out.

dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ダメだって言ったのに……言ったのに……ど
　うして音夢ちゃんなの！？　ダメだよ！」
dialogues.en: "I told you not to...... I said that. Why Nemu-chan? No!"
dialogues.text: "I told you not to...... I said that. Why Nemu-chan? No!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「白河さんも、美春ちゃんも、水越さん達だっ
　ているんだよ！？」
dialogues.en:
"Why can't it be Shirakawa-san or Miharu-chan? Or even one
of the Mizukoshi sisters?"
dialogues.text:
"Why can't it be Shirakawa-san or Miharu-chan? Or even one
of the Mizukoshi sisters?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: そんなに何に必死なのかが理解できない。
dialogues.en: I can't understand why she's so upset.
dialogues.text: I can't understand why she's so upset.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボク、お兄ちゃんがボク以外の人を好きになっ
　たら潔く身をひくつもりだったのに……」
dialogues.en:
"I was planning to let go of you if you decide to like
someone beside me."
dialogues.text:
"I was planning to let go of you if you decide to like
someone beside me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でも、音夢ちゃんだけはダメなんだよ……」
dialogues.en: "But not Nemu-chan. It can't be Nemu-chan......"
dialogues.text: "But not Nemu-chan. It can't be Nemu-chan......"

dialogues.jp: さくらが俯いて声を殺す。
dialogues.en: Sakura looked down, speaking in a low voice.
dialogues.text: Sakura looked down, speaking in a low voice.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、なに言って――」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん新聞取りに行ったまま――あっ、さく
　らちゃん。おはよう」
dialogues.en:
"How long does it take you to get the newspapers? Hey,
Sakura! Good morning."
dialogues.text:
"How long does it take you to get the newspapers? Hey,
Sakura! Good morning."

dialogues.jp:
振り返った先で、サンダルを履いた音夢が表に
出てくる。
dialogues.en: I turned around and saw Nemu coming out of the house.
dialogues.text: I turned around and saw Nemu coming out of the house.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うにゃ、音夢ちゃんおはよ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Hi Nemu-chan! Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Hi Nemu-chan! Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さく、ら？」
dialogues.en: "Saku... ra?"
dialogues.text: "Saku... ra?"

dialogues.jp: 先ほどまでのシリアスさがさっぱり抜けて――。
dialogues.en: She looked totally different......
dialogues.text: She looked totally different......

dialogues.jp: いや、違う。
dialogues.en: No, it's not that.
dialogues.text: No, it's not that.

dialogues.jp:
そう――さくらの｛・・・・・・・／外見と内面の差｝を、今、まざ
まざと見せつけられたのだ。
dialogues.en:
She just showed me the difference between how she looks and
what her personality's like.
dialogues.text:
She just showed me the difference between how she looks and
what her personality's like.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「へ……へくしゅ！」
dialogues.en: "Ah... Achoo!"
dialogues.text: "Ah... Achoo!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「音夢ちゃんまだ調子悪い？」
dialogues.en: "Are you still not feeling well?"
dialogues.text: "Are you still not feeling well?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いや、なんか……くしゅ……ん、花粉症
　みたいな感じで」
dialogues.en:
"Well, no. It's more like...... achoo...... like an
allergy."
dialogues.text:
"Well, no. It's more like...... achoo...... like an
allergy."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「こんな朝からなに立ち話してるんです――
　って、うたまるさんだ〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"What are you guys talking about so early in the morning?
Hello, Utamaru-san!!"
dialogues.text:
"What are you guys talking about so early in the morning?
Hello, Utamaru-san!!"

dialogues.jp:
俺の肩に手をあてて背伸びして、音夢が白猫を
なでる。
dialogues.en:
She leaned against my shoulders to stand up on her toes and
touch the white cat.
dialogues.text:
She leaned against my shoulders to stand up on her toes and
touch the white cat.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うたまるさん可愛いね〜。この子、頭とか手
　とか、肩にものりそうだよね」
dialogues.en:
"You're so cute, Utamaru. I'm sure you could sit her on your
head or hands, or even on your shoulders, don't you think?"
dialogues.text:
"You're so cute, Utamaru. I'm sure you could sit her on your
head or hands, or even on your shoulders, don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あははは、可愛い♪　兄さんやっぱり猫飼お
　うよ」
dialogues.en: "You're so cute. I think we should get a cat too, niisan."
dialogues.text: "You're so cute. I think we should get a cat too, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それはダメだ」
dialogues.en: "No, we shouldn't."
dialogues.text: "No, we shouldn't."

dialogues.jp: 俺は強く拒否する。
dialogues.en: I rejected that idea strongly.
dialogues.text: I rejected that idea strongly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うぅ……猫」
dialogues.en: "I want a cat......"
dialogues.text: "I want a cat......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「これだけは絶対にダメ！」
dialogues.en: "I said no!"
dialogues.text: "I said no!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちぇ」
dialogues.en: "Boo."
dialogues.text: "Boo."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が俺から離れて物欲しげに猫を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked at the cat as she moved away from me.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked at the cat as she moved away from me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあさ、１日だけ預かってみる？」
dialogues.en: "How about you take care of him for a day?"
dialogues.text: "How about you take care of him for a day?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、いいの！？」
dialogues.en: "Can I do that?"
dialogues.text: "Can I do that?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「その代わりお兄ちゃん１日貸して」
dialogues.en: "But you have to let me borrow oniichan for a day."
dialogues.text: "But you have to let me borrow oniichan for a day."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ね、お兄ちゃん。積もる話もあるでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't we have a lot to talk about, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Don't we have a lot to talk about, oniichan?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが目を細めて小さく微笑む。
dialogues.en: Sakura narrowed her eyes and smiled a little bit.
dialogues.text: Sakura narrowed her eyes and smiled a little bit.

dialogues.jp: 俺に対しての演技を止めたのだろう。
dialogues.en: I think she stopped acting in front of me.
dialogues.text: I think she stopped acting in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
その瞳には、子供らしい無邪気さというよりも、
悪女めいた悪戯な光が浮かんでいる。
dialogues.en:
Her eyes looked mischievous, unlike the innocent smile she
had a moment ago.
dialogues.text:
Her eyes looked mischievous, unlike the innocent smile she
had a moment ago.

dialogues.jp:
それは、音夢の猫かぶりなんてレベルの変化で
はない。
dialogues.en:
I realized it was like when Nemu put on different faces
sometimes.
dialogues.text:
I realized it was like when Nemu put on different faces
sometimes.

dialogues.jp: 「お前な……」

｛えりくび／襟首｝つかんで問い詰めたい話はあるのだが、そ
の含みでは音夢を挑発しているようなものだ。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to ask her questions, but Nemu would be suspicious
if I did that.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to ask her questions, but Nemu would be suspicious
if I did that.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、その……いや、そんな貸し借りなんて」
dialogues.en:
"Well...... exchanging your cat for my brother seems kind
of......"
dialogues.text:
"Well...... exchanging your cat for my brother seems kind
of......"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked up to me.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked up to me.

dialogues.jp: さくらも俺を見上げている。
dialogues.en: Sakura's looking at me as well.
dialogues.text: Sakura's looking at me as well.

dialogues.jp:
深い青い――ばあちゃんと同じ瞳が俺を見上げ
ている。
dialogues.en:
Her deep blue eyes, just like her grandma's, are looking up
at me.
dialogues.text:
Her deep blue eyes, just like her grandma's, are looking up
at me.

dialogues.jp: どうなのだろう……。
dialogues.en: And then I wonder......
dialogues.text: And then I wonder......

dialogues.jp: 俺はさくらに｛だま／騙｝されていた。
dialogues.en: I think Sakura's deceiving me.
dialogues.text: I think Sakura's deceiving me.

dialogues.jp:
だが、どこまでが嘘かと考えたときには、こい
つが俺を破滅させるために｛・・／子供｝を演じていたと
は思えないのだ。
dialogues.en:
But when I think back to see how much of how she acted
towards me was a lie, I don't think she was acting childish
just to deceive me.
dialogues.text:
But when I think back to see how much of how she acted
towards me was a lie, I don't think she was acting childish
just to deceive me.

dialogues.jp:
再会した時の嬉しい顔とか、いつか公園を歩い
ていたときに繋いだ手のぬくもりとか。
dialogues.en:
The way she looked so happy to see me again, and the way her
hand was so warm when we walked in the park......
dialogues.text:
The way she looked so happy to see me again, and the way her
hand was so warm when we walked in the park......

dialogues.jp: 多分、こいつが芳乃さくらだから――。
dialogues.en: Maybe it's because she's Sakura.
dialogues.text: Maybe it's because she's Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
ただ逆に、こいつが芳乃さくらだからこそ、俺
以外の人間に対する気持ちは分からない。
dialogues.en:
But at the same time, I don't understand how she feels about
other people beside me.
dialogues.text:
But at the same time, I don't understand how she feels about
other people beside me.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.jp: ◆貸し借り◆
dialogues.en: ◆Making it even◆
dialogues.text: ◆Making it even◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢の進学ストップの通知を一番に受け取ろう
と、最近はずっと朝早くから郵便受けを覗き込
んでいた。
dialogues.en:
I looked in the mailbox to find the letter from school about
Nemu not being able to go back to school. I wanted to get
that letter first.
dialogues.text:
I looked in the mailbox to find the letter from school about
Nemu not being able to go back to school. I wanted to get
that letter first.

dialogues.jp:
そんな時、さくらと音夢と３人が集まることと
なり、うたまる好きの音夢を察して、さくらが
俺と交換で１日を過ごさないかと言う。
dialogues.en:
And so it happened that Sakura and Nemu came out by the
mailbox and since Nemu wanted a ca, Sakura offered to
exchange Utamaru for me for a day.
dialogues.text:
And so it happened that Sakura and Nemu came out by the
mailbox and since Nemu wanted a ca, Sakura offered to
exchange Utamaru for me for a day.

dialogues.jp: 音夢は俺からは慣れたくないと視線を送るが、
dialogues.en:
Nemu looked at me like she didn't want to be separated from
me.
dialogues.text:
Nemu looked at me like she didn't want to be separated from
me.
